name: id
description: Defines a unique identifier for the element.

name: class
description: Assigns one or more class names to the element.

name: style
description: Applies inline CSS styles to the element.

name: title
description: Provides advisory information about the element, often shown as a tooltip.

name: hidden
description: Indicates that the element is not yet, or is no longer, relevant.

name: tabindex
description: Specifies the tab order of the element.

name: draggable
description: Specifies whether the element is draggable.

name: contenteditable
description: Indicates whether the element's content is editable.

name: accesskey
description: Defines a keyboard shortcut to activate or focus the element.

name: lang
description: Specifies the language of the element's content.

name: dir
description: Specifies the text direction for the element.

name: role
description: Defines the ARIA role of the element for accessibility.

name: aria-hidden
description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to assistive technologies.

name: aria-label
description: Provides an accessible label for assistive technologies.

name: aria-expanded
description: Indicates whether a collapsible element is expanded.

name: aria-controls
description: Identifies the element controlled by the current element.

name: aria-live
description: Indicates how updates to the region should be announced by assistive technologies.

name: name
description: Specifies the name of the element, used for form submission or identification.

name: value
description: Defines the current value of an element.

description: Indicates whether the element is exposed to assistive technologies.

name: role
description: Defines the ARIA role of an element for accessibility.

name: lang
description: Specifies the language of the element's content.

name: dir
description: Specifies the text direction of the element.

name: autofocus
description: Automatically focuses the element when the page loads.

name: aria-label
description: Defines an accessible label for assistive technologies.

name: aria-expanded
description: Indicates whether a collapsible element is expanded.

name: aria-controls
description: Identifies the element controlled by the current element.

name: aria-live
description: Indicates how updates to the region should be announced by assistive technologies.

name: href
description: Specifies the URL of a linked resource.

name: target
description: Specifies where to open the linked document.

name: rel
description: Defines the relationship between the current document and the linked resource.

name: type
description: Specifies the MIME type of the linked or embedded resource.

name: src
description: Specifies the URL of an embedded resource.

name: alt
description: Provides alternative text for images.

name: srcset
description: Defines multiple image sources for responsive images.

name: sizes
description: Defines image display sizes for responsive images.

name: decoding
description: Hints how the browser should decode the image.

name: loading
description: Indicates how the browser should load the resource.

name: crossorigin
description: Controls CORS settings for the resource.

name: autoplay
description: Specifies that the media should start playing automatically.

name: loop
description: Specifies that the media should restart when it reaches the end.

name: muted
description: Indicates that the audio output of the media should be muted.

name: controls
description: Displays playback controls for the media.

name: preload
description: Provides a hint to the browser about what to preload for the media.

name: poster
description: Specifies an image to be shown while the video is downloading or until the user hits play.

name: referrerpolicy
description: Controls how much referrer information is sent when fetching a resource.

name: sandbox
description: Applies extra restrictions to the content inside an iframe.

name: allow
description: Specifies feature policy permissions for an iframe.

name: allowfullscreen
description: Indicates that the iframe is allowed to request fullscreen.

name: autocomplete
description: Specifies whether the browser should provide autocomplete suggestions.

name: placeholder
description: Provides a hint describing the expected value of the input.

name: required
description: Indicates that the user must fill in the value before submitting.

name: disabled
description: Indicates that the element is not available for interaction.

name: readonly
description: Indicates that the user cannot modify the value.

name: min
description: Specifies the minimum value allowed.

name: max
description: Specifies the maximum value allowed.

name: step
description: Specifies the legal number intervals for the input.

name: pattern
description: Defines a regular expression the input value must match.

name: colspan
description: Specifies how many columns a cell should span.

name: rowspan
description: Specifies how many rows a cell should span.

name: headers
description: Associates table cells with header cells.

name: scope
description: Indicates the scope of a header cell in a table.

name: UNSIGNED
description: Specifies that a numeric column cannot store negative values.

name: DEFAULT
description: Assigns a default value to a column when no value is provided.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE t (active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE);

name: NOT NULL
description: Ensures a column cannot store NULL values.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE t (name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL);

name: PRECISION
description: Defines the total number of digits allowed in a numeric type.

name: SCALE
description: Defines the number of digits allowed after the decimal point.

name: LENGTH
description: Specifies the maximum size of a character or binary column.

name: WITH TIME ZONE
description: Indicates that a timestamp or time value includes time zone information.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE t (created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE);

name: YEAR/MONTH/DAY/HOUR/MINUTE/SECOND
description: Defines precision for temporal fields or interval components.
codeExample: CREATE TABLE t (duration INTERVAL DAY TO SECOND);

name: CHECK(JSON_VALID(metadata))
description: Ensures that a column contains valid JSON data.

name: SRID
description: Specifies the spatial reference identifier for geometry columns.

name: COLLATE
description: Defines the collation used for sorting and comparing text.
codeExample: SELECT name FROM users ORDER BY name COLLATE 'en_US';

name: LEADING
description: Removes leading characters when used with TRIM.

name: TRAILING
description: Removes trailing characters when used with TRIM.

name: BOTH
description: Removes leading and trailing characters when used with TRIM.

name: TOP
description: Limits the number of rows returned in SQL Server.

name: ALL
description: Returns all rows or disables DISTINCT behavior.

name: VALUES
description: Defines literal row values for INSERT or SELECT.

name: DEFAULT VALUES
description: Inserts a row using only default column values.

name: SET
description: Assigns new values to columns in UPDATE statements.

name: WHERE
description: Filters rows in queries or DML operations.
codeExample: DELETE FROM users WHERE active = FALSE;

name: FROM
description: Specifies the source table for a query.

name: AND
description: Combines multiple logical conditions.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users WHERE active = TRUE AND age > 18;

name: OR
description: Provides alternative logical conditions.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users WHERE role = 'admin' OR role = 'editor';

name: NOT
description: Negates a logical condition.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users WHERE NOT active;

name: HAVING
description: Filters grouped query results.
codeExample: SELECT role, COUNT(*) FROM users GROUP BY role HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;

name: DESC
description: Sorts results in descending order.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY created DESC;

name: OFFSET
description: Skips a number of rows in a result set.

name: INNER
description: Performs an inner join between tables.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a INNER JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

name: LEFT
description: Performs a left outer join.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a LEFT JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

name: RIGHT
description: Performs a right outer join.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a RIGHT JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

name: FULL
description: Performs a full outer join.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a FULL JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

name: ON
description: Defines join conditions.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b ON a.id = b.id;

name: USING
description: Defines join conditions using shared column names.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM a JOIN b USING (id);

name: WHEN
description: Starts a conditional branch in CASE expressions.
codeExample: SELECT CASE WHEN active THEN 'yes' END FROM users;

name: THEN
description: Defines the result of a CASE condition.
codeExample: SELECT CASE WHEN active THEN 'yes' END FROM users;

name: ELSE
description: Provides a fallback result in CASE expressions.
codeExample: SELECT CASE WHEN active THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END FROM users;

name: END
description: Closes a CASE expression.
codeExample: SELECT CASE WHEN active THEN 'yes' END FROM users;

name: AS
description: Assigns an alias to columns or tables.
codeExample: SELECT name AS username FROM users;

name: DISTINCT
description: Removes duplicate rows from a result set.

name: OVER
description: Defines a window for window functions.
codeExample: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY id) FROM users;

name: PARTITION BY
description: Divides rows into partitions for window functions.
codeExample: SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY role ORDER BY id) FROM users;

name: ORDER BY
description: Sorts query results.
codeExample: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY name;

name: PATH
description: Specifies a JSON path expression.

name: RETURNING
description: Returns affected rows from DML operations.
codeExample: INSERT INTO users(name) VALUES('A') RETURNING id;

name: PASSING
description: Passes external values into JSON/XML functions.

name: WITH GRANT OPTION
description: Allows the recipient of a privilege to grant it to others.
codeExample: GRANT SELECT ON users TO bob WITH GRANT OPTION;

name: CASCADE
description: Automatically removes dependent objects or privileges.
codeExample: REVOKE SELECT ON users FROM bob CASCADE;

name: IDENTIFIED BY
description: Sets a password for a user.

name: DEFAULT ROLE
description: Assigns a default role to a user.
codeExample: ALTER USER bob DEFAULT ROLE admin;

name: ACCOUNT LOCK
description: Locks a user account.

name: ACCOUNT UNLOCK
description: Unlocks a user account.

name: SESSION
description: Modifies session-level settings.

description: color selection
percentage

name: absolute
description: removes an element from the normal document flow and positions it precisely relative to its nearest positioned ancestor

name: auto
description: auto configuration

name: block
description: forces an HTML element to behave as a block-level element

name: bold
description: bold text

name: center
description: a keyword used across several layout and formatting properties to position content in the middle of its container

name: colors
description: this value references the ability to use a color

name: column
description: dictates that a flex container stacks its items vertically from top to bottom

name: contain
description: isolates an element and its descendants from the rest of the document tree

name: cover
description: scales an image or video so that it completely fills its container while preserving its original aspect ratio

name: currentColor
description: represents the computed value of an element's color property

name: dashed
description: dashed style border / outline

name: default
description: Forces the platform-dependent default cursor to show regardless of context.

name: deg
description: degree

name: dotted
description: dotted style corder / outline

name: double
description: double style border / outline

name: ease
description: specifies an animation or transition effect with a slow start, then speeds up quickly, and finally ends slowly

name: ease-in
description: specifies a timing effect that starts slowly and then progressively accelerates until the end of the duration, where it stops abruptly

name: ease-out
description: defines a transition or animation that starts at full speed and gently decelerates (slows down) as it approaches the end

name: em
description: a relative length unit whose exact value depends on where it is applied

name: end
description: to place items at the end edge of the alignment container along the relevant axis

name: fixed
description: is a value for the position property that pins an HTML element relative to the viewport

name: flex
description: shorthand applied to flex items (the direct children of a flex container). It controls how an item grows or shrinks to fit the available space.

name: font-family
description: font family

name: fr
description: the fr unit stands for a fraction of the available space inside a CSS Grid container.

name: grid
description: a shorthand that allows you to configure an entire grid layout within a single rule

name: hex
description: represents the ability to use hexadecimal color

name: hsl()
description: defines a color in the sRGB color space using three primary components: Hue, Saturation, and Lightness, along with an optional Alpha channel for transparency

name: inherit
description: forces an element to take the computed value of a property from its parent element. It can be applied to any CSS property on any HTML element, including shorthand properties like all

name: initial
description: applied directly to a CSS property to reset it to its official W3C specification default value

name: inline
description: to an element, it generates one or more inline boxes that flow horizontally alongside text and other elements without creating line breaks before or after themselves

name: inline-block
description: creates an element that behaves like an inline element on the outside but a block element on the inside

name: italic
description: italic version of a font

name: justify
description: typically refers to how elements or text are spaced and aligned along their horizontal or inline axis

name: keyword
description: predefined text-based strings defined by the W3C specification that tell the browser exactly how to render a property

name: left
description: specifies the horizontal position of a positioned element

name: linear
description: used as an easing value or function to ensure that an animation, transition, or transformation progresses at the exact same speed from start to finish without acceleration or deceleration

name: linear-gradient()
description: gradient of color following a line

name: minmax()
description: defines a size range greater than or equal to a minimum value and less than or equal to a maximum value

name: ms
description: milliseconds

name: no-repeat
description: property to prevent a background image from tiling. When applied, the background image is displayed exactly once within its container

name: none
description: none

name: normal
description: use browser standard

name: not-allowed
description: property value displays a red circle with a diagonal slash through it

name: nowrap
description: a keyword value used with text-formatting properties to prevent text from breaking or wrapping to a new line

name: number
description: represents using a number

name: number(0-1)
description: sets level of opacity

name: pointer
description: defines the mouse pointer's visual appearance when it hovers over an element

name: px
description: pixels

name: relative
description: places an element relative to its normal position in the document flow

name: rem
description: a relative length unit that is calculated based on the font size of the root element (the <html> element) of the web page

name: repeat()
description: represents a repeated fragment of a track list, allowing patterns of columns or rows to be written in a compact form

name: revert
description: rolls back a property's value to what it would have been if the current style origin (your website's stylesheet) had made no changes to the element

name: rgb()
description: color scheme

name: rgba()
description: color scheme

name: right
description: align to the right

name: rotate()
description: a transformation that turns an element around a fixed point on a 2D plane

name: row
description: allows manipulatiuon of a flex box row

name: s
description: seconds

name: scale()
description: allows for scale transformation

name: solid
description: solid border style

name: start
description: beginning of container

name: static
description: default positioning behavior for almost every HTML element. When an element is static, it follows the natural, normal layout flow of the web page

name: sticky
description: creates a hybrid element that behaves like a relative positioned element until it reaches a specified scroll threshold, at which point it acts like a fixed positioned element

name: table
description: table style display container

name: text
description: property value changes the mouse pointer into an I-beam symbol

name: translate()
description: moves an element from its original position along the horizontal (X) axis and vertical (Y) axis

name: transparent
description: represents transparent color

name: unset
description: acts as a dynamic reset for a CSS property. It behaves as a "smart choice" between two other global CSS values—inherit and initial—depending on whether the target property is naturally inherited from its parent element

name: url()
description: used to include an external file or resource in a stylesheet

name: vh
description: a relative length unit where 1vh is equal to 1% of the total height of the browser's viewport

name: vw
description: a relative length unit where 1vw is equal to 1% of the total width of the browser's viewport

name: wrap
description: allow elements or text to break and flow onto a new line when they run out of space
